text:
alice: just finished the rollout for v2.3.7 to canary -> prod. running the miniscan quickchecks now. overall green but a tiny tail on one probe :mag_right:
deploy-bot: deploy complete for release v2.3.7 by alice. automated miniscan: 18/20 checks OK, 1 degraded, 1 noisy. details: https://deploys.internal/release/2.3.7 :robot_face:
alice: degraded check is the postlaunch watchdog against /api/v1/embeds (p95). not seeing 5xxs but p95 jumped ~350ms -> 540ms. tagging oncall. @ben @carol
ben: oncall here, looking. any traffic shift notes? hub shows no big traffic delta. maybe cold kv cache or quant variant? :thinking_face:
carol: quick probe run from target cluster:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-probe/quick -d '{"route":"/api/v1/embeds","samples":50}' | jq .summary
{"p50":120, "p95":540, "errors":0}
```
carol: errors 0 in probe, but tail latency consistent across 3 runs. metrics show host-level GC spikes on two nodes at the same time.
ops-bot: synthetic-watchdog alert: embed-route tail-latency > 500ms for 00:00:30. affected hosts: gpu-12, gpu-19. rolling warmup recommended. :warning:
ben: ok let's avoid a rollback for now. plan: 1) spin warmup job to prefill KV on affected hosts 2) route ~10% traffic off the 2 hosts for 5m 3) re-run miniscan. if errors > 0.5% or p95 > 700ms -> pin to previous model variant and trigger rollback window.
alice: agree. initiating warmup and temporary routing. adding to release notes: "postlaunch: warmup applied to gpu-12/gpu-19 after minor tail latency"
carol: warmup job kicked:```yaml
job: kv-prefill
targets: [gpu-12,gpu-19]
rate: 200rps
duration: 3m
```
deploy-bot: routing update: shifted 10% traffic off gpu-12,gpu-19 at 01:02 UTC. warmup job started. :arrow_right_hook:
carol: re-ran probe after warmup: p95 -> 190ms, errors 0. mini-checks all green now.
ben: nice. I'll keep an eye on the dashboards for the next 15m. if it stabilizes we leave as-is and doc in release notes. if it flaps we'll pin and roll back. :white_check_mark:
alice: thanks team. I'll finalize release notes and mark this as monitored for the 1hr window. closing thread unless anyone objects. :raised_hands:
ben: no objections.
carol: all good from infra side.
ops-bot: monitoring entry created: release:v2.3.7 -> watch window 60m, recovery action: warmup+partial-reroute."
